proposal.root_cause: Commit 30832ac added securityContext.runAsNonRoot: true to the worker container, but python:3.12-alpine runs as root and no runAsUser is set, so kubelet raises CreateContainerConfigError.
proposal.rationale: The pod event says "container has runAsNonRoot and image will run as root". The only change in 30832ac is the added securityContext block. Reverting it restores the previous working spec. I did not pick a runAsUser because no manifest in the repo gives a grounded UID.
proposal.verify: The worker pod's container starts and reaches Running, and the Deployment rolls out with no CreateContainerConfigError.

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: api
  namespace: demo

    app: api

spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: api
        app.kubernetes.io/version: "1.0.0"
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: api
          image: python:3.12-alpine
          command: ["python", "/app/app.py"]
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8000
          env:
            - name: APP_VERSION

                name: api-config
          volumeMounts:
            - name: code
              mountPath: /app
              readOnly: true
          readinessProbe:

              path: /healthz
              port: 8000
            periodSeconds: 5
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: 8000
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 10
          resources:
            requests:
              memory: 96Mi
              cpu: 50m
            limits:
              memory: 128Mi
              cpu: 500m
      volumes:
        - name: code
          configMap:
            name: api-code
